fact: Gartokkar Xundorn materializes from invisibility near the party shortly after Dorhun departs.
source_quote: Barely had Dorhun departed when a duergar materialized out of thin air nearby
subject: Gartokkar Xundorn

fact: Gartokkar introduces himself as a representative of the Keepers of the Flame.
source_quote: He introduced himself as Gartokkar Xundorn of the Keepers of the Flame
subject: Gartokkar Xundorn

fact: The Keepers of the Flame have a sacred duty to tend to the red dragon Themberchaud.
source_quote: his order's sacred duty was to tend to the red dragon Themberchaud
subject: Keepers of the Flame

fact: Themberchaud is a red dragon who keeps the city's forges burning.
source_quote: the red dragon Themberchaud, who kept the city's forges burning
subject: Themberchaud

fact: The Deepking treats the Keepers of the Flame as his most prized advisors.
source_quote: the Deepking treated the Keepers as his most prized advisors
subject: Keepers of the Flame

fact: Gartokkar flashes a badge to disperse curious onlookers.
source_quote: flashed a badge that sent curious onlookers scattering
subject: Badge display

fact: The party perceives Gartokkar as a legal authority capable of making other authorities disappear.
source_quote: has the ability to make the other authorities disappear
subject: Gartokkar Xundorn

fact: Gyrgum jokes that they have kindling available if the order is short on dragons.
source_quote: Gyrgum drily offered that they had some kindling available if the order was running short on dragons
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gartokkar laughs at Gyrgum's joke and then dissects it with analytical precision, extinguishing the humor.
source_quote: Gartokkar laughed, then dissected the joke with such analytical precision that every trace of humor was methodically extinguished
subject: Humor dissection

fact: Daz notes that dragon cults usually wear purple robes.
source_quote: Daz adds that they usually have purple robes
subject: Daz

fact: Gartokkar invites the party to his quarters by the following day to discuss a specific task.
source_quote: He invited the party to his quarters by the following day
subject: Job offer

fact: Gartokkar offers city passes and legal immunity in exchange for the party's help.
source_quote: In exchange for their help with a problem he was not yet ready to name, he promised city passes and what Thorin summarized as "a limited get-out of jail-free card."
subject: Payment offer

fact: Gartokkar has a problem he is not yet ready to name that requires the party's help.
source_quote: help with a problem he was not yet ready to name
subject: Mysterious problem

fact: Zalthir has an 'I know a guy' list, allowing one favor per city to learn about factions or obtain items.
source_quote: the GM reminded Zalthir of his "I know a guy" list: one favor per city
subject: Zalthir's contacts

fact: The party has already sent someone to fetch them a magical weapon.
source_quote: the GM also reminds the party they have already sent someone to fetch them a magical weapon
subject: Magical weapon delivery

fact: The party decides to get a drink rather than immediately seeking out the stone giant, the dragon, or the Blade Bazaar.
source_quote: They settle on getting a drink
subject: Party decision
